title: Tools for Monitoring Performance Counters and Events

facts.text: Windows Performance Monitor collects and displays performance data from counters and trace events in real time or logs.
Event Viewer on Windows displays Business Central Server events in Applications and Services Logs.
Logman.exe command-line tool manages event trace sessions and performance logs on Windows.
Get-WinEvent PowerShell cmdlet retrieves Business Central Server instance events from Windows event logs.
PerfView analyzes performance issues related to Event Tracing for Windows data.
Microsoft TraceEvent Library provides classes for controlling ETW providers and parsing events.
